rules.label: Full charity discount (0-250% FPL)
rules.quote: Federal Poverty Levels based on total household income, with sufficient supporting documentation provided by the patient, will have a 100% Charity discount processed

rules.label: Partial charity discount (251-400% FPL)
rules.quote: For patients whose documented income is between 251 and 400 percent of the Federal Poverty Level, we have an expanded financial assistance policy that may reduce the amount you owe

rules.label: Hospital Discounted Care (Colorado law, <=250% FPL)
rules.quote: For patients whose income is at or below 250% of the Federal Poverty Guidelines, the limits to how much the hospital can charge must follow the rules of Hospital Discounted Care

eca_not_before.quote: Tell you in writing 30 days before they send you to collections

payment_plan.quote: You do not owe any more money after: You make 36 monthly payments, or You pay the full discounted amount in your payment plan

notes: Policy applies to non-elective care only; elective cosmetic procedures and facility designated self-pay flat rate procedures are excluded from uninsured discount.
Some locations may have additional criteria for charity eligibility (high medical costs, more lenient income levels).

Medicare beneficiaries require independent income and resource verification (PRM-I § 312); preferred documentation is most current year's Federal Tax Return, or two pieces from: State Income Tax Return, Most Recent Employer Pay Stubs, Written documentation from income sources, Copy of all bank statements for last three months, Current credit report.
Uninsured discount amount may vary by location based on state requirements, patient income levels, and local rates.
Hospital Discounted Care is a Colorado law; patients may qualify regardless of citizenship or immigration status, and even if they have health insurance.
If uninsured patient refuses hospital screening for public programs, they cannot sue the hospital for not giving discounts or not checking for programs.
Determination must be communicated within 21 days of completed application; appeal must be filed in writing within 30 days of decision date.
Before collections: hospital must bill insurance first (if applicable), explain all services and fees in patient's preferred language, and provide 30-day written notice.
Payment plan amount depends on income; bills must be split into monthly payments.
HealthONE Cares makes no guarantees regarding accuracy of pricing information; estimates may differ substantially from final bills.
